comparison.objective: Candidate separates mixed finishing media and washers using a manual screen; board-TK-3DAUWV selects required conveyor parts and assembles the pictured model while rejecting look-alikes.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests bimanual screen grasping, pouring, tilt/agitation, bridge clearing, and reseating; the board task tests timed conveyor interception, staging, visual part selection, and sequential stacking/assembly.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate grades mass passed through real apertures, washer retention, zero spill/damage, and released dwell; the board task grades four-part model geometry, distractors riding off the belt, absence of belt jams, and a 1 s hold.
comparison.reason: The complete board specification was available; conveyor handling and generic placement do not duplicate orientation-dependent granular screening, and no comparison-critical rubric detail is missing.
